items.name: c-event-calendar-1
items.title: Event calendar with all views and live settings
items.description: Event calendar with all views and live settings
items.descriptionLong: Event calendar with all views and live settings. Built by composing Avatar, Button, Card, Event Calendar, Event Calendar Content and 8 more. Uses date-fns alongside the shadcn primitives. A free, open source shadcn event calendar example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-event-calendar-1 and edit as your own code.

items.descriptionLong: Event calendar with create and edit dialog. Built by composing Button, Card, Dialog, Event Calendar, Event Calendar Content and 6 more. Uses cn, date-fns alongside the shadcn primitives. A free, open source shadcn event calendar example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-event-calendar-3 and edit as your own code.
